forward_pwm_pin.description: RPWM, hardware PWM (forward -- the frequent, performance-critical direction)

reverse_pwm_pin.description: LPWM, software PWM (reverse -- parking/recovery only, tolerates the jitter)

r_en_pin.description: Held permanently HIGH at connect() -- these gate the module's overcurrent/thermal protection, not direction. Physical BCM number vs the module's own R_EN/L_EN silkscreen doesn't matter now that both are always HIGH (it mattered under the old shared-PWM/EN-toggle design; see git log).
